select last_insert_id()
insert into orders (user_id, order_date, order_status, order_totalprice) values (#{user_id}, now(), '주문 완료', #{order_totalprice})

insert into deliver( order_id, deliver_name, deliver_person, deliver_recipient_phone, deliver_loc, deliver_detail_loc, deliver_request, deliver_status, deliver_date ) values( #{order_id}, #{deliver_name}, #{deliver_person}, #{deliver_recipient_phone}, #{deliver_loc}, #{deliver_detail_loc}, #{deliver_request}, '배송 준비중', now() )
insert into orders_products( order_id, product_id, op_quantity, op_price, op_date, op_totalprice ) values( #{order_id}, #{product_id}, #{op_quantity}, #{op_price}, now(), #{op_totalprice} )
insert into payment( order_id, payment_type, payment_date, payment_status, payment_price ) values( #{order_id}, '카카오결제', now(), '결재완료', #{payment_price} )
mapper.select: SELECT o.order_id, o.user_id, o.order_date, o.order_status, o.order_totalprice FROM orders o WHERE o.order_id = #{order_id}

SELECT o.order_id, o.user_id, o.order_date, o.order_status, o.order_totalprice, u.user_name, u.user_email, u.user_tel, d.deliver_id, d.deliver_name, d.deliver_person, d.deliver_recipient_phone, d.deliver_loc, d.deliver_detail_loc, d.deliver_request, d.deliver_status, d.deliver_date, p.payment_id, p.payment_type, p.payment_status, p.payment_price, p.payment_date FROM orders o LEFT JOIN user_detail u ON o.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN deliver d ON o.order_id = d.order_id LEFT JOIN payment p ON o.order_id = p.order_id WHERE o.order_id = #{order_id} LIMIT 1

SELECT op.orders_products_id, op.order_id, op.product_id, op.op_quantity, op.op_price, op.op_totalprice, p.product_name, pi.product_imgurl FROM orders_products op LEFT JOIN product p ON op.product_id = p.product_id LEFT JOIN product_img pi ON p.product_id = pi.product_id AND pi.product_img_type = '메인' WHERE op.order_id = #{order_id} ORDER BY op.op_date ASC

SELECT o.order_id, o.user_id, o.order_date, o.order_status, o.order_totalprice, p.payment_type, p.payment_status, p.payment_date FROM orders o LEFT JOIN payment p ON o.order_id = p.order_id WHERE o.user_id = #{user_id} ORDER BY o.order_date DESC
SELECT order_id, user_id, order_date, order_status, order_totalprice FROM orders WHERE user_id = #{user_id} ORDER BY order_date DESC
